description: 2 tactical challenges for Black against the Alekhine-Chatard Attack. Slow it with 6...a6! or trade the attacker.

drills.briefExplanation: 5...Nfd7 6.h4 a6! 7.Nf3 c5 — retreat, slow the storm, then break.
drills.description: Black to play. White is threatening the Chatard 6.h4 — retreat 5...Nfd7 and prepare 6...a6!.
drills.explanation: The patient defense: after 5...Nfd7 6.h4, Black plays 6...a6! — a useful waiting move that slows White's queenside ideas. After 7.Nf3 c5 Black strikes in the center, the classic French counter. White's h-pawn adventure looks premature when the center opens — the storm passes, the structure remains.
drills.name: Slowing the Storm

drills.briefExplanation: 6...Bxg5! 7.hxg5 Qxg5 — trade the pinning bishop and take the pawn.
drills.description: Black to play. White launched 6.h4 — trade on g5 and grab the pawn.
drills.explanation: The concrete defense: 6...Bxg5! removes the pinning bishop, and after 7.hxg5 Qxg5 Black has won the h-pawn — White's 'attack' cost a pawn and achieved nothing. The queen on g5 eyes g2, Black's development is easy, and the Chatard is refuted by simple tactics. Trade the attacker, take the material.
drills.name: Trading the Attacker

name: Alekhine-Chatard Attack — Black Tactics
